title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 7:15-23
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 7:15-23</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: The Messianic Torah (2024).
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="15" /> Watch out for illegitimate <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="green">prophets</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        who come to you in the clothing of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">sheep</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        but inside they are <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">wolves</char> who snatch. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="1" type="secondary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="secondary">
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
          <verse number="16" /> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="turquoise">By their fruits you will recognize them</char>. 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary">
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="b">
          Do people gather <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="green">grapes</char> from <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">thorn-bushes</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          or <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="green">figs</char> from <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">thistles</char>? 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="c">
          <verse number="17" /> Similarly, every <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="green">good</char> tree <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">produces</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="green">good fruit</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="3" sidebar-value="d">
          but the diseased tree <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">produces</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">bad fruit</char>. 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="c'">
          <verse number="18" /> A <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="green">good</char> tree is not able to <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">produce</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">bad fruit</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="3" sidebar-value="d'">
          and diseased can’t <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">produce</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="green">good fruit</char>. 
        </group>
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="b'">
          <verse number="19" /> Every tree that doesn’t <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">produce</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="green">good fruit</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2">
          it is cut down and thrown into <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">the fire</char>. 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A'" type="secondary">
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
          <verse number="20" /> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="turquoise">So then, by their fruit you will recognize them</char>. 
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="21" /> Not <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">everyone who says to me</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          “<char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">Master, master!</char>”
        </group>
        <group>
          will enter into <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">the kingdom of the skies</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          but rather the one who does the desire of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">my Father in the skies</char>. 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="22" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">Many will say to me</char> on that day, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          “<char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">Master, master</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2">
          didn’t we <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="green">prophesy</char> in your name, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2">
          and cast out demons in your name, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2">
          and do many mighty acts in your name?”
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="23" /> And then <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">I will confess to them,</char>
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          “I have never known you; 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          go away from me, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          you who act as if there is no law.” 
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
